Maria K.: Bringing up the AMS GPU cluster, starting perf validation. tagging @Ajay P. for kernel/driver checks.
Ajay P.: on it — I'll run the driver sanity first. did ops already apply the nvidia-driver 535.104?
Diego R.: yes, images built with 535.104 + CUDA 12.2. posted AMI id in #eng-infra-docs.
Ajay P.: ok. first checks: `nvidia-smi`, `nvidia-persistenced` status, `modinfo nvidia` -> make sure version matches. also verify MIG not enabled on these nodes.
Sophie L.: I kicked off the basic smoke jobs (small model inference, 4 concurrent connections) — results are attached in the artifacts link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/ams/boot-1823458765
Maria K.: quick reminder: network MTU needs to be 9000 between host NICs for bulk transfer tests. is that configured on the fabric?
Diego R.: MTU set to 9000 on the BGP fabric and the leaf switches. I saw one host with 1500, patching it now.
Ajay P.: running kernel checks: `dmesg | grep -i nvidia` and `journalctl -u kubelet` for any driver load errors. also checking for `pcie_aspm` warnings.
infra-bot: Deploy job ams-bootstrap-3 completed by Diego R. status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
Ajay P.: found one kernel oops from yesterday on node-07 related to iommu; marking node-07 as quarantine for now.
Sophie L.: benchmark plan for today: 1) single-GPU p95 latency baseline (small prompt) 2) multi-GPU NCCL throughput (4-way) 3) large sequence stress to measure KV cache behavior.
Maria K.: for p95 baseline use the reference model: owl-3b-quant. run 1000 requests with steady concurrency=8. target p95 < 40ms for short prompts.
Ajay P.: running single-GPU job: `wrk` script invoked, saving logs to /tmp/ams-p95-1823458765.log. initial p95 = 62ms on node-12 (higher than target).
Diego R.: node-12 on different NIC lane — check IRQ balance and CPU pinning for the inference process. sometimes default irqaffinity causes high latency.
Sophie L.: also confirm `nv-peer-mem` is present if using GPUDirect RDMA for multi-node NCCL.
Ajay P.: IRQs looked skewed, moved worker to CPU set 4-7, p95 dropped to 38ms. good catch. :thumbsup:
Maria K.: excellent. note in runbook: after image bootstrap, verify irqbalance config + systemd cpusets for inference container runtime.
Sophie L.: running NCCL allreduce test across 4 GPUs on a single host: achieved 42 GB/s aggregate, roughly in expected range.
Diego R.: multi-node NCCL cross rack not enabled yet — holding until we verify rack-level MTU and jumbo frames end-to-end.
Ajay P.: driver/kernel note: we saw occasional `GPUDirect` fallback when `mlx5_core` had firmware mismatch. flag for ops: ensure Mellanox firmware v18.35.101 or newer.
Maria K.: adding a step to the handoff checklist: "validate switch firmware and Mellanox drivers match recommended versions".
Sophie L.: stress test (long sequence) revealed KV cache leak after ~6 hours in the stress harness — file opened: INC-AMS-1823458765. assigning to @Diego R.
Diego R.: ack, reproducing locally. looks like shader memory fragmentation on older CUDA runtime path. I'll repro with heap profiling.
Maria K.: Handoff status: nodes (except node-07 quarantined) green for SMOKE + p95 baseline + single-host NCCL. still pending: cross-rack NCCL and KV leak fix.
Ajay P.: recommended bootstrap checklist (short):
  - verify kernel driver (nvidia) version matches image string
  - check `dmesg` for rejects/oops
  - confirm MTU=9000 end-to-end
  - ensure irqbalance/cpuset tuned for inference runtime
  - validate Mellanox firmware and `mlx5` driver
  - run single-GPU p95 job and compare to golden baseline
  - run NCCL single-host throughput test
  - mark node as quarantined if any kernel oops or persistent driver errors
Maria K.: I'm going to patch the runbook with these steps and schedule a handoff doc + 30min walkthrough tomorrow. who can join at 10:00 UTC?
Sophie L.: I can.
Diego R.: I can — will bring notes on KV leak.
Ajay P.: yep, I'll join and bring kernel logs.
infra-bot: Reminder: cluster-handoff meeting created for 2026-03-19 10:00 UTC — link: https://meet.internal/meet/ams-handoff-1823458765
Maria K.: thanks team. saving final results to artifacts and will open a short post with quick checklist and failing nodes.
Sophie L.: +1, thanks all.
Diego R.: rolling node-07 to diagnostic image now.
Ajay P.: closing the thread for now, please update INC-AMS-1823458765 with findings.
